channel.title: Cadence 步频 — PT Research Signal
channel.description: Daily curated physical therapy & rehab research for clinicians. AI-scored signal from 50 sources.

item.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 1
item.description: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services estimates a 1-3% overall payment increase for physical therapy codes under the Calendar Year 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Proposed Rule, despite a proposed 1.68% decrease to the conversion factor.
item.author: APTA

item.title: CMS News: CMS Announces Nationwide Expansion of Proven Joint Replacement Program
item.description: CMS is expanding its bundled payment program for hip and knee replacements nationwide, impacting reimbursement and care delivery models for physical therapy providers.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
item.description: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses confirms structured exercise training effectively manages fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, with effects varying across modalities and fatigue instruments.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association has released a revised clinical practice guideline for the physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, featuring 20 new recommendations based on a systematic review of current literature.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to standard physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain may improve outcomes, potentially addressing adherence issues.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) demonstrated that remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation is feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, improving exercise capacity and quality of life.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (44 RCTs, 9951 patients) found hydrodilatation for idiopathic adhesive capsulitis to be efficacious compared to other interventions, with a mean hydrodilatation volume of 36.0±26.3 mL.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis: a randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
item.description: This randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial protocol investigates if contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis.
item.author: J NeuroEng Rehabil

item.title: Effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
item.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis protocol aims to evaluate the effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia.
item.author: BMC Geriatrics

item.title: Delaying Early Morning Training Time in Swimmers: Effects on Sleep, Recovery and Performance—A Randomized Controlled Trial
item.description: This randomized controlled trial protocol investigates whether delaying early morning training time in swimmers affects sleep, recovery, and performance.
item.author: Sports Med - Open

item.title: Neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improves dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
item.description: A randomized controlled trial found that neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improved dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
item.author: BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil

item.title: The 2027 Proposed Rule is Out. Here's What You Need to Know.
item.description: WebPT provides an overview of the 2027 Proposed Rule for Medicare, highlighting potential impacts on physical therapy reimbursement.
item.author: WebPT

item.title: Advocates, Leaders Drive Payment Momentum During APTA Payment Advocacy Summit
item.description: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit convened 450 advocates and leaders to drive momentum for physical therapy payment policies, focusing on practice sustainability and patient access.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
item.description: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrated strong content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability, with high agreement between in-person and video-call assessments for bradykinesia in Parkinson's disease.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Sarcopenia as an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies found sarcopenia to be an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults.
item.author: BMC Geriatrics

item.title: Temperature-dependent effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion on recovery: a systematic review and meta-analysis | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
item.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis protocol aims to evaluate the temperature-dependent effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion on recovery.
item.author: BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil

item.title: Eight weeks of focal muscle vibration shows improvements in muscle co-ordination and co-contraction in cerebral palsy children: a randomized control trial | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
item.description: This randomized controlled trial protocol investigates whether eight weeks of focal muscle vibration improves muscle coordination and co-contraction in cerebral palsy children.
item.author: J NeuroEng Rehabil

item.title: Effect of 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training on muscle stiffness, muscle co-activation, and balance in older individuals | European Review of Aging and Physical Activity
item.description: This randomized controlled trial protocol evaluates the effect of 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training on muscle stiffness, muscle co-activation, and balance in older individuals.
item.author: Eur Rev Aging Phys Act

item.title: Functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women: randomized controlled trial
item.description: This randomized controlled trial protocol compares functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women.
item.author: Sport Sci Health

item.title: Prior Authorization Process for Certain Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) Items
item.description: CMS provides background and updates on the prior authorization process for certain Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) items, designed to ensure compliance and timely beneficiary access.
item.author: CMS
